dedupe_keys.name: ch rpv300 hourly rooftop pv potential profiles for switzerland aggregated to transmission grid nodes 2008 to 2019

description: CH-RPV300 gives hourly rooftop photovoltaic generation profiles for Switzerland for 12 weather years, 2008 to 2019, aggregated to the nodes of the Swiss electricity transmission grid. Per grid node it resolves 48 orientation and tilt combinations, five installation size classes from 1 to 1000 kWp and three flat-roof design scenarios (winter-optimised, annual-optimised and east-west), giving about 8,550 candidate rooftop PV generators nationwide. Variables are hourly power in Wh, installed capacity in Wp by size class and normalised capacity factor profiles in Wh per Wp, with Voronoi shapefiles of the aggregation zones for two grid versions of 135 and 126 nodes. Profiles are derived from satellite-based HelioMont irradiance downscaled to 300 m with terrain shading, combined with the Sonnendach roof inventory of more than 10 million roof surfaces and a simplified PV model. EnviDat, the WSL data portal, published it in 2026 as NetCDF-4 files in two zip archives of about 5.9 and 4.5 GB, available for free download under CC BY-SA 4.0 with a data description file. Coverage is Switzerland. Caveats: the PV model uses fixed efficiency, performance ratio and roof cover factors, and only roofs of at least 1 kWp are included. Simulation uses are nodal rooftop PV supply for transmission expansion, storage and winter adequacy studies. Related records: data-swiss-sonnendach-roof-solar-suitability is the underlying roof inventory.
